title: Oil Whispers: Essential Oils with doTERRA | Yoga Momente
description: Oil Whispers by Susanne Müller: essential oils as companions for body and emotions, consultation, oil samples and joining as a doTERRA wellness advocate.

sections.title: The power of oils
sections.lead:
Experience Oil Whispers:
essential oils as daily companions for body and soul.

sections.title: What can the oils do?
paragraphs: They are 100 % pure, natural and highly effective in laying a good foundation for a healthy lifestyle.
sections.imageAlt: doTERRA Balance essential oil blend (15 ml)

sections.title: What do I offer?
paragraphs: You benefit from my knowledge of health and consulting, on the one hand from my professional background, on the other from my yoga path with an interest in movement, nutrition and relaxation.

I share my enthusiasm not only in personal consultations but gladly at group meetings too. One of my values is a positive outlook on life with the motto: there is no such thing as “can’t”, just do it.
**This is how we can work together:**

Grow at your own pace, independently and individually

items.title: Cooperation around essential oils
items.sub: This is where the oils are put to sensible and ideal use:
items.foot: Do you work in health care or in the service sector? Let us look together at how the oils can enrich and further enhance your work.

infobox.text: In our yoga classes, too, yogis get to enjoy the oils. I am happy if I can infect you with my enthusiasm and you carry the oils on as an advocate yourself.

sections.title: How can I get started?
paragraphs: With enthusiasm and curiosity for oils and health, you discover how versatile the oils are to use, what effects they have and how to use them correctly.
I am happy to accompany you on your start.

aside.title: I am happy to send you oil samples.
aside.text: Feel free to “whisper” your topic (sleep, digestion, pain, mood) to me. Get in touch for more info!
